prompts.description: 一个高度结构化的 JSON 提示，用于生成一张年轻女子身着比基尼和皮草帽，置身于白雪皑皑的高山环境中的图像。它细致地描述了拍摄对象的身体特征、服装、姿势、环境、相机设置和光线，以呈现一张逼真、高保真的生活方式照片。

prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成 Krithi Shetty 超逼真的影棚美妆肖像，她面带恼怒的表情。场景采用高调布光，突出大胆的红色口红，她的脸上散布着多个红色口红吻痕，她正咬着一张写有“Fucking Valentine's Day”的卡片。提示中详细说明了相机设备、灯光和化妆品广告级别的细节。
prompts.content:
Krithi Shetty's face (or preserve the facial features, face shape, bone structure, hair color, makeup except lip color, and eye color from the reference image). Ultra-realistic studio beauty portrait of a young woman with model-like facial proportions, age around 20-25. Camera: strict frontal portrait, eye-level camera, symmetrical centered composition, shot on Hasselblad X2D, 105mm lens, butterfly lighting with beauty dish, soft fill light. Expression: annoyed irritated face, furrowed brows, displeased pouting lips, biting the corner of a white card with her teeth in frustration. Makeup: bold red lipstick, multiple red lipstick kiss marks scattered across the face — on the forehead, both cheeks, neck, and near the collarbone area. Clean refined eye makeup, natural skin glow. Hair: dark brown hair slicked back smoothly into a low bun. Outfit: red satin corset top, off-shoulder style exposing shoulders and collarbones, no necklace, no bow, bare neck and décolletage. Accessories: ruby red crystal drop earrings, red crystal cocktail ring, red nail polish. Props: biting and tearing the corner of a white card with her teeth, the card reads "Fucking Valentine's Day" in handwritten red script with lipstick kiss marks on it. Background: clean white studio, bright even soft lighting, high-key beauty shoot atmosphere. 8K, high resolution, cosmetic advertising level skin detail.

prompts.title: 超逼真的高地湖泊自拍
prompts.description: 一个高度详细的提示，用于生成一张超逼真的 iPhone 风格自拍照，画面中一位年轻女性身处风景优美的高山湖畔，强调真实的皮肤纹理、自然日光，以及包含山脉、水面倒影和前景芦苇的复杂背景。
prompts.content:
Ultra-detailed photorealistic selfie of a beautiful young woman with delicate feminine features, long straight light brown hair flowing smoothly over her shoulders, and clear blue eyes softly reflecting natural daylight. She has subtle, natural makeup — light foundation with visible realistic skin texture, soft peach blush, lightly glossed lips, gently defined brows, and a natural glow. A soft, relaxed smile enhances her warm and approachable expression.

She is holding the camera at arm’s length in true iPhone-style selfie perspective, creating a slightly close, intimate framing with mild wide-angle lens distortion typical of a smartphone front camera. Her posture is casual yet elegant, shoulders relaxed, head slightly tilted toward the light. One arm is extended toward the camera while the other rests naturally near her waist.

She wears an elegant sleeveless white V-neck jumpsuit/dress featuring a deep plunge neckline and refined button details running vertically down the front. The fabric appears lightweight yet structured, softly contouring her silhouette. A matching belt cinches at the waist, emphasizing her figure. The material catches the sunlight with gentle highlights and subtle shadows, revealing realistic folds and texture.

Accessories include statement crystal drop earrings that sparkle in the sunlight, a delicate gold necklace with a small pendant resting just above her neckline, multiple thin bracelets layered on her wrist, and a fine chain bracelet adding a subtle shimmer. The jewelry reflects natural light with crisp, high-detail clarity.

The setting is a scenic highland lake during a warm sunny day. A wooden railing appears along the side of the frame, adding depth and context to the composition. In the foreground, lush green reeds and marsh grasses frame the bottom edge of the image. Behind her, calm reflective lake water mirrors the sky, while distant reddish-brown mountains and rolling hills stretch across the horizon. The sky is partly cloudy with soft white clouds drifting across a vibrant blue background.

Natural outdoor portrait photography style with cinematic lighting, balanced exposure, vibrant yet realistic colors, sharp focus on the subject’s face, softly blurred background (subtle depth of field), high dynamic range, ultra-high resolution 8k detail, crisp skin texture, realistic hair strands, natural shadows, and warm sunny atmosphere. Professional mobile photography aesthetic, hyper-realistic, immersive, detailed environmental storytelling.
prompts.translatedContent:
一位年轻美女的超精细写实自拍，她拥有精致柔美的五官，一头浅棕色长直发柔顺地披在肩上，清澈的蓝色眼睛柔和地反射着自然日光。她化着淡雅自然的妆容——轻薄的粉底，可见真实的皮肤纹理，柔和的桃色腮红，微带光泽的嘴唇，眉毛轻柔勾勒，散发着自然的光泽。她柔和放松的笑容，更添温暖亲切的表情。

她以真实的 iPhone 式自拍视角，手臂伸直举着相机，营造出略微贴近、亲密的构图，带有智能手机前置摄像头典型的轻微广角镜头畸变。她的姿态随意而优雅，双肩放松，头部略微倾向光源。一只手臂伸向相机，另一只则自然地放在腰部附近。

她穿着一件优雅的无袖白色深 V 领连体裤/连衣裙，领口深邃，正面垂直排列着精致的纽扣细节。面料看起来轻盈而有型，柔和地勾勒出她的身形。一条配套的腰带束在腰间，凸显了她的身材。面料在阳光下泛着柔和的光泽和微妙的阴影，展现出逼真的褶皱和纹理。

配饰包括在阳光下闪闪发光的醒目水晶吊坠耳环，一条精致的金色项链，小吊坠恰好落在领口上方，手腕上叠戴着多条细手链，以及一条细链手链增添了微妙的光泽。珠宝在自然光下反射出清晰、高细节的光芒。

背景是一个阳光明媚的温暖日子，在一个风景优美的高山湖泊。画面一侧出现木制栏杆，为构图增添了深度和背景。前景中，郁郁葱葱的绿色芦苇和沼泽草构成了图像的底部边缘。在她身后，平静的湖水倒映着天空，远处红褐色的山脉和连绵起伏的丘陵延伸至地平线。天空局部多云，柔软的白云飘浮在充满活力的蓝色背景上。

自然户外人像摄影风格，电影级光线，曝光均衡，色彩鲜艳逼真，主体面部对焦锐利，背景柔和虚化（微妙的景深），高动态范围，超高分辨率 8k 细节，清晰的皮肤纹理，逼真的发丝，自然阴影，以及温暖阳光的氛围。专业的手机摄影美学，超现实，沉浸式，细节丰富的环境叙事。

prompts.title: 超逼真健身房镜子自拍
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一张超逼真的镜面自拍，画面中有三位年轻女性（米莉·芭比·布朗、娜塔莉亚·戴尔和艾玛·沃特森的肖像），她们身处现代健身房，强调“运动后光泽”的美学效果，皮肤因汗水而闪亮，并采用高亮度荧光照明。
prompts.content:
Subject & Composition:

A high-quality mirror selfie of three fit young women standing close together in a modern gym. The woman on the left is holding a sleek black smartphone to take the photo. They are posed playfully, huddled together with a post-workout glow. The woman on the left has her hair in a messy ponytail with bangs; the middle woman has soft fringe bangs and a ponytail; the woman on the right has a sleek, pulled-back ponytail.

Clothing & Style:

Left: A light pastel blue spandex athletic set consisting of a racerback sports bra and matching biker shorts.

Middle: A soft dusty pink athletic set with thin straps and matching biker shorts.
 
Right: A neutral tan or beige high-waisted leggings set with a matching sports bra.
 
Details: Small minimalist athletic logos are visible on the chest of each sports bra.
Atmosphere & Lighting:
The scene is set in a brightly lit professional gym with white walls and bright overhead rectangular fluorescent lights. The background features wall-to-wall mirrors, rows of black dumbbells on racks, and workout benches. The floor is a dark, textured gym mat.

Skin & Texture:
Ultra-realistic skin textures featuring a heavy "sweat-glistening" effect and "glass skin" aesthetic. Their complexions are dewy and flushed from exercise. The image has a sharp focus, high-definition quality, and the naturalistic look of a high-end smartphone camera.

Key Elements for AI Generation
 
Vibe: "Athletic realism," "Post-workout glow," "Gym aesthetic."
 
Technical: "8k resolution," "Photorealistic," "Depth of field," "Shot on iPhone 15 Pro."
 
Lighting: "High-key lighting," "Fluorescent gym lights," "Reflective surfaces."
prompts.translatedContent:
主题与构图：

一张高质量的镜面自拍，三位身材健美的年轻女性在现代健身房里紧密站立。左边的女性手持一部时尚的黑色智能手机拍照。她们摆出俏皮的姿势，紧挨在一起，散发着运动后的光彩。左边的女性扎着凌乱的马尾辫，留着刘海；中间的女性留着柔软的齐刘海和马尾辫；右边的女性扎着光滑的后梳马尾辫。

服装与风格：

左：一套浅柔和蓝色氨纶运动服，包括一件工字背运动文胸和配套的骑行短裤。

中：一套柔和的脏粉色运动服，细肩带和配套的骑行短裤。

右：一套中性米色或米黄色高腰紧身裤套装，配有配套的运动文胸。

细节：每件运动文胸的胸部都可见小巧简约的运动标志。

氛围与光线：

场景设置在一个光线明亮的专业健身房，白色墙壁和明亮的顶部矩形荧光灯。背景是整面墙的镜子、架子上成排的黑色哑铃和健身凳。地板是深色纹理的健身垫。

皮肤与质感：

prompts.title: 情人节天使之心魅力大片
prompts.description: 一个极其详细的 JSON 提示，用于制作一张超写实魅力时尚肖像，主题为情人节。主体人物坐落在一个大型的、蕾丝边心形镂空内，背景是闪闪发光的亮粉色亮片，身穿红色羽毛迷你连衣裙，并佩戴大型白色天使翅膀。

prompts.title: 诱惑楼梯抓拍照片
prompts.description: 一个高度具体的提示，用于生成一张超逼真、带有暗示性的抓拍照片：一名斯拉夫裔金发女性在夜间走上公寓楼梯间。提示中包含详细的人物锁定参数（纤细丰满的身材、铂金色的头发）、服装细节（超短裙、过膝袜）和拍摄视角（低角度、iPhone 15 Pro Max 效果），并限制内容为暗示性而非露骨。

prompts.title: 都市时尚画册拼贴
prompts.description: 一个复杂的提示，指示将上传的图像转换为 64K DSLR 风格的 3x3 拼贴画，内容为时尚都市时装摄影。它详细说明了拍摄对象的形象、服装（酒红色帽子、白色运动衫）、各种抓拍姿势、都市环境细节（鹅卵石、红色灯笼灯光），以及 Octane 渲染和虚幻引擎等技术要求。
prompts.content:
Transform this image [Upload Your Image] into a 64K DSLR shot resolution of a stylish urban fashion photoshoot presented as a 3x3 collage, featuring a young man (same face as the uploaded image) captured in candid lifestyle poses across a modern city setting. He has short straight brown hair, light skin, and wears black rectangular eyeglasses. His outfit is minimal and coordinated: a deep burgundy baseball cap with subtle embroidered text, an oversized white sweatshirt with a small elegant graphic logo on the chest, burgundy tailored trousers with a clean modern fit, and clean white sneakers. He carries a small black crossbody bag in some frames.

Each panel captures a different natural pose adjusting his glasses, walking, leaning against a wall, turning casually, lifting one arm confidently, or holding the brim of his cap, creating a relaxed, confident, everyday fashion mood. His expressions range from thoughtful and calm to cheerful and carefree.

The setting is an outdoor urban environment with modern architecture, cobblestone walkways, neutral-toned buildings, large wooden planters, and leafless trees decorated with red lantern-style lights. One central frame features a classic storefront façade labeled “[Add Text],” adding a European café street aesthetic.

Backgrounds are softly blurred, emphasizing the subject while maintaining environmental context. Lighting is natural daylight with soft shadows, overcast tones, and balanced exposure. The color palette is cohesive and elegant, burgundy reds, crisp whites, muted greys, and warm wood tones, creating a refined street-style look.

Textures are realistic: cotton fabric folds, natural fabric movement, leather accessories, and stone pavement. Shot in high resolution, lifestyle fashion photography style, shallow depth of field, editorial composition, authentic street photography feel, clean framing, modern Instagram lookbook aesthetic, minimal color grading, soft contrast, natural motion capture.

prompts.translatedContent:
将此图片 [上传您的图片] 转换为 64K 单反相机拍摄分辨率的时尚都市时装摄影，以 3x3 拼贴形式呈现，其中一位年轻男士（与上传图片中的面部相同）在现代都市环境中摆出随意的生活姿势。他留着短直棕发，皮肤白皙，戴着黑色长方形眼镜。他的着装简约协调：一顶带有精致刺绣文字的深酒红色棒球帽，一件胸前带有小巧优雅图形标志的超大白色运动衫，一条剪裁合身、现代感十足的酒红色长裤，以及一双干净的白色运动鞋。在某些画面中，他背着一个黑色小斜挎包。

每个画面都捕捉了不同的自然姿势——调整眼镜、走路、靠墙、随意转身、自信地举起一只手臂，或扶着帽檐，营造出一种轻松、自信、日常的时尚氛围。他的表情从沉思平静到开朗无忧。

场景是户外都市环境，拥有现代建筑、鹅卵石小径、中性色调的建筑、大型木制花盆和挂有红色灯笼式灯饰的枯树。其中一个中心画面展示了一个标有“[添加文字]”的经典店面，增添了欧洲咖啡馆街头美学。

背景柔和模糊，突出主体，同时保留环境背景。光线是自然日光，带有柔和的阴影、阴天色调和均衡的曝光。调色板协调优雅，包括酒红色、纯白色、柔和灰色和暖木色调，营造出精致的街头风格。

纹理逼真：棉织物褶皱、自然织物运动、皮革配饰和石板路。以高分辨率拍摄，生活时尚摄影风格，浅景深，编辑构图，真实的街头摄影感，干净的构图，现代 Instagram 型录美学，最小的色彩分级，柔和的对比度，自然运动捕捉。

Octane 渲染与虚幻引擎。
